summary: Verified fix for /apply document upload error. Backend: POST /api/applications/documents PDF 200 (file_id/name/url), text/plain 415 German msg, admin download 200 with matching bytes, anon 401, POST /api/applications with documents List[Dict] 201 and persisted. Frontend (Playwright, desktop): welcome gate accepted (Deutschland + role), step1 + step2 filled (tax id 12345678995 accepted), step3 PDF into Personalausweis -> 200, filename shown, Weiter enabled; PNG into Adressnachweis -> 200, filename shown; no 'Fehler beim Hochladen' alert, no stuck 'Wird hochgeladen...'. text/plain rejected client-side with German alert. Step4 summary shows '2 Datei(en)'. Final UI submit not executed: requires camera-based AI identity/liveness flow (not automatable headless); submit path covered by backend test.

ui_bugs.issue: uploadingDoc is a single global flag, so all remaining slots show 'Wird hochgeladen...' while one file uploads (cosmetic).
e.target.value is not reset after upload/error, so re-selecting the same file after a failed upload doesn't fire onChange.

action_items: Optional: reset e.target.value='' in finally of handleDocumentUpload
Optional: track uploading state per docType
Note: public upload RL 5/min/IP - a user retrying several docs could hit 429 (message shown via alert detail, acceptable)
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct: frontend posts multipart to /api/applications/documents via getApiBase(); backend validates type/size/doc_type and stores in storage_files; documents schema now List[Dict] with max_length=20. No issues blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_Upload application + 3 TEST_ storage_files; cleaned up (application deleted, files soft-deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public upload rate limit 5/min per IP is shared between pytest and Playwright - wait 60s between runs. Step4 submit requires AI identity flow with camera.
